snippet.title: API vs MCP vs CLI, Explained in 60 Seconds
snippet.description:
There are three ways your AI agent can talk to software. APIs, MCPs, and CLIs.

APIs are powerful but need docs, keys, requests, and auth handling. A lot of work for your agent to figure out.

MCPs wrap the API in a menu so your agent gets a list of tools, but they eat up context.

CLIs are the leanest. Run a command, get text back. No docs, no token cost.

For anything running on your machine, CLIs win right now.

Follow for more AI agent tips.
